parts.name: Chassis plate
parts.does: The deck everything else bolts to.
parts.dims: 250 x 100 mm footprint, 4 mm thick
parts.print_note: Print flat as modeled. Suggestion: 3-4 walls, ~25% infill.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.does: Rolls on the ground; one per wheel position on the robot.
parts.dims: 66.2 mm diameter x 25 mm wide, 6 mm shaft hole
parts.print_note: Print flat as modeled. Suggestion: print one first and check the shaft fit before printing the rest.

params.name: shaft_diameter_mm
params.source: assumption — typical DC gearmotor shaft; measure yours

params.name: hub_diameter_mm
params.source: derived — 0.4 x wheel diameter, for looks/strength

params.name: lightening_hole_diameter_mm

parts.name: Motor mount
parts.does: Side plate that holds one drive motor so its shaft lines up with a wheel's axle.
parts.dims: 41 mm wide plate, shaft hole at axle height 33.1 mm
parts.print_note: Suggestion: 40% infill — this part takes the motor's twist. The motor itself is not a printed part.

params.name: shaft_center_height_mm
params.source: from spec wheel radius (diameter_m / 2) — the axle height above ground

params.name: mount_width_mm
params.source: derived — wheel width + 16 mm of plate around the motor

params.name: mount_height_mm
params.source: derived — reaches from the ground past the axle to the chassis plate

params.name: shaft_hole_diameter_mm
params.source: derived — shaft diameter + 0.4 mm slip fit

params.name: flange_depth_mm
params.source: assumption — how far the bolting flange reaches under the chassis

parts.name: Caster
parts.does: Ball caster that keeps a two-wheel robot level (one front, one rear). Placeholder for a real ball-caster unit.
parts.dims: ball diameter 30 mm (= ground clearance, so the ball tops out at the deck)
parts.print_note: Suggestion: expect a loose fit — sand or scale 1-2% for a snug cup. A bought ball caster rolls far better.

params.name: caster_ball_diameter_mm
params.source: from spec ground_clearance_m — ball top meets the deck underside

params.name: caster_stem_height_mm
params.source: derived — reaches into/past the deck plate for bolting

parts.name: Lidar mount
parts.does: Post that raises the 2D lidar to the top of the robot so its scan plane clears the chassis.
parts.dims: post 170 mm tall, top disc 70 mm diameter
parts.print_note: Print upright as modeled. Suggestion: ~25% infill; the lidar itself is not a printed part.

params.name: post_height_mm
params.source: derived — spec height minus deck and disc thicknesses

params.name: lidar_disc_diameter_mm
params.source: assumption — typical 2D lidar puck; measure yours
